description: Create a persistent sandbox microVM, optionally from a snapshot or template image. Returns the session (id, state) and its data-plane endpoint. Boots in ~2s. Use tenki_exec / tenki_read_file / tenki_write_file against the returned session_id.

clone_repo_url.description: Git URL to clone into the sandbox on boot.

env.description: Environment variables as a key→value object.

image.description: Boot from a template image, passed as a reference STRING: the imageDigestRef of a READY build from tenki_build_template / tenki_get_template_build (e.g. 'ws/name@sha256:...'), or 'workspace/name' for its latest version.

wait_ready.description: Poll until the sandbox is RUNNING before returning (default true).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to create in (defaults to the key's first workspace).

name: tenki_create_sandbox
